caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical bands in three colors: blue, red, and off-white. The central area consists of a square with smaller red and off-white checks, bordered by larger red squares. On either side of the central square, there are thick vertical blue bands with smaller blue horizontal stripes intersecting them, forming a dense grid in these sections. Thinner red bands run vertically along the edge of the thick blue sections as well as between the blue and central red sections. The off-white sections form a background grid, separating the colored bands and providing contrast. The entire patterned section is placed on a beige background with visible discoloration along the top edge of the page, and the word "top" is handwritten in pencil above the fabric pattern.
title: Coverlet: Gentleman's Fancy
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
